Lambeth's SADPD Proposed Submission Version is undergoing examination.

The SADPD is intended to secure benefits for communities.
The SADPD is intended to improve the quality of places and the environment.

The Lambeth New Homes Programme monitors housing delivery on council-owned land.
The New Homes Programme maps and monitors housing delivery and estate renewal across delivery stages.
The programme monitors progress against delivery targets.
The programme is intended to make best use of grants and subsidies.
The programme takes a site-by-site approach to delivery.
The site-by-site approach considers market factors.
The site-by-site approach considers site opportunities and constraints.
The site-by-site approach considers availability of subsidy.
The site-by-site approach considers council finances and risk appetite.
The programme prioritises access to affordable housing.
The programme pipeline includes existing development sites.
The programme pipeline includes newly identified development sites.
The programme pipeline includes estate renewal projects.
The New Homes Programme aims to deliver at least 600 additional affordable homes on council-owned land by 2030.
The New Homes Programme prioritises homes at social rent.
Lambeth reported 92 new homes planned at Leigham Court Road in Streatham.
The Leigham Court Road scheme includes a new community building.
The Leigham Court Road scheme uses three small pieces of land including a former car park.

Construction at Leigham Court Road was stated to be set to begin in early 2026.
The Leigham Court Road scheme was estimated for completion by 2029.
